name: PT Sinar Mas Multiartha Tbk
summary: PT Sinar Mas Multiartha Tbk provides financial products and services to individual and corporate customers in Indonesia. The company engages in the banking, life insurance, loss insurance, multi finance, securities, technology-based lending and borrowing services, venture capital, share register, money changer, workshop, property, information service, and trading and service businesses. It is also involved in the reinsurance, asset management, forestry, on-line insurance, commodity trading, data processing, and credit guarantor services, as well as operation of auction and pawnshop businesses, and real estate business.
